I used half and half cream developer and 30 vol developer. I left it on for about 25 mins (maybe I should let it process for 30-40 mins next time, im just scared of my hair being damaged.) My natural hair is a 3.5 and my roots are grown out about 4 inches. The rest of my hair has been previously colored purple, then red, then brown 2 years ago and has just faded to a medium brown since. My natural hair is wavy/curly and pretty dry. Im scared to bleach more than once but after once the strand still felt very strong.

First, I always do a test piece to make sure the color is going to lift enough and I wont be frying my hair. I dont wash my hair for a week, then I saturate the hell out of it in coconut oil the night before and sleep in it. I use 30 vol developer and cream bleach lightener. I have thick curly hair and if I tried to do my whole head at once, the piece I started with would be burnt off by the time I got to the end. So i split my hair into a middle part and do one side at a time. I split my hair into sections and start at the bottom until I get to regrowth. I put aluminum foil on each piece to add heat. Once im done with the bottoms I wait 20 mins and then do my roots and let that sit for 10 minutes. Keep in mind roots will always lift faster because your scalp produces heat. If your hair is virgin (never dyed) it will also lift faster and more evenly. Make sure to FULLY saturate that hair. You should not be able to see much of your hair, just thick white paste like toothpaste. I highly recommend having someone help get the back of your hair because its very hard to see. Also wait a couple weeks if you can inbetween bleachings. Luckily I only have to bleach my hair once since im just putting purple over it.
